Meet the Presiding Pastor in Charge

Pastor Enoch Folorunsho

Serving The Lords City Gospel Grace Ministry with a passion for the true Word of God, prophetic prayer, and seeing people grow into the destinies God has for them.

His heart for the ministry

Raised to raise destinies

Pastor Enoch's ministry is centred on helping people hear and understand God's Word, seek Him in prayer, and find strength to walk in their calling. Through worship, teaching and the church's prayer gatherings, he seeks to make room for people to encounter God's grace and grow in faith.
